This is the most useful translation PR we have had in a while, and I want to be straight with you about what happened to it.

We merged a bulk pass on September 8th that filled the missing keys in every locale, so the new strings in your PR now collide with ours. That part is redundant through no fault of yours, your PR was open first.

The other 44 changes are not redundant at all, and we have taken them. You caught things nobody had looked at in years: `Ta bort from tavla` with the English word still in it, `serverConnectionFailed` left completely untranslated, "bräden" for boards when the rest of the file says "tavlor", "E-mail" instead of "E-postadress", and the date format block still carrying the English "at". Those are real bugs, and the format block in particular is something our own tooling cannot detect.

Your corrections to the existing strings are in, along with the login and markdown editor ones, and we kept our versions of the new keys so the file ends up consistent. It is on master now.

If you want to go through the new strings we landed and fix anything that reads badly in Swedish, please do. You clearly know this file better than we do.
I see this has now been fixed on `master` in `ad532605` and #1779 has been closed. I'm closing this PR as superseded. Thanks!

Merged, thank you. This is a real gap closed, and wrapping the existing label keys instead of inventing new text for every button was the right call.

Three things we did on top rather than sending the PR back to you.

The tooltip now stays hidden on touch devices. With hover and focus as triggers, tapping a button gives it focus and the tooltip appears over the interface, which is not what anyone wants on a phone.

We replaced the `switchToView` key. "Switch to {{view}} view" with a view name interpolated into it needed `t('common.' + view).toLowerCase()` at the call site, and lowercasing an already translated string goes wrong in German, where nouns are capitalised, and in Turkish, where it turns I into ı. There are now five complete strings, one per view, and no lowercasing.

And we filled the new keys into all 35 locales rather than just en-US and ru-RU, so the release does not ship a partly translated tooltip layer.

None of that is a criticism of the PR. They were just faster for us to do than to describe.
2.3.0 adds `@name` mentions in card descriptions (f23ce6e0, 2413ddd1), next to the existing comment mentions, plus comment replies.
